title: Generic Evaluation Provenance Producer
hard_guards: private root must remain outside repository
all source files and supporting evidence are SHA-256 verified
route kind and runtime artifact must match E07/E08
operational fields require explicit evidence-id coverage
benchmark aggregates are computed from logical run records rather than hand-entered summary values
duplicate benchmark run ids are rejected
G1 pass without an evaluable G1 run is rejected
differential exact-input is computed from input SHA equality
differential usability delta and material inferiority are derived from raw review records
review ids are hashed in internal derivation locks
generated output bytes are deterministic for identical inputs
mutated generated outputs fail replay verification
public provenance receipt emits hashes/locks but no private paths, raw reviewer ids, raw audio, contract text or billing records
E09 differential schema now permits and requires comparison_state used by E09 runtime decision code
external_gaps: no actual commercial/runtime source artifacts were supplied
no rights-cleared G1/G2 real audio was supplied
no actual separation benchmark runs were supplied
no current-iPhone Moises exact-input review corpus was supplied
